style: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production mobile Unity RPG perk icon. Match the supplied existing game helmet and coin references: extremely simple chunky flat-color casual medieval cartoon, very thick smooth near-black outlines, rounded geometric silhouettes, 3 to 5 flat colors, at most one hard cel shadow, no gradients, no glow, no texture, no realism, no lettering, no numbers, no frame, no tile, no background scene. A SINGLE isolated centered icon, transparent RGBA background, square canvas. Keep all artwork within central 80%, generous clear transparent margin. It must read at 64px. Colored artwork (not a monochrome glyph). Do not copy the helmet or coin subject unless required.
